turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on a, an and the?
turns.tutor:
Hi there! Sure. Quick reminder: "a" + consonant sound (a cat), "an" + vowel sound (an orange). In English we need this little word before one thing.

Try this. Write a or an: She has ___ orange in her bag.

Please write just one word.

C1 (correct) strength 0: a singular countable noun needs a/an (or the). Independent correct productions so far: 0.
